summary: H World Group filed a Form 6-K announcing completion of a CNY3.35 billion offering of 2.25% senior unsecured bonds due 2031, placed offshore under Regulation S to non-U.S. persons outside the United States. Net proceeds are earmarked for general corporate purposes. Listing of the bonds on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange is expected effective September 17, 2026. This is a routine debt capital raise by an issuer, not a special situation: no change of control, no equity stake, no tender or strategic review. Watch for leverage and refinancing signals, but no arbitrage angle exists.
